risks: The company may be unable to raise additional capital needed to grow its business.

growth_drivers: [growth driver; technology and product] SharonAI Holdings Inc. provides enterprise, government and research organizations with access to advanced accelerated computing hardware.
[growth driver; technology and product] SharonAI Holdings, Inc. shifted focus to developing and delivering GPU Cloud services in response to market demand.
[growth driver; demand and growth] The market for GPU Cloud services has shown strong theoretical demand, with significant interest from AI developers and enterprises.
risks: [risk; margins and costs] The Company's obligations under these contracts include ongoing infrastructure support, equipment maintenance, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
[risk; share structure and dilution] The fair value of stock-based awards is measured at the grant date and recognized as expense over the requisite service period.

growth_drivers: SharonAI upgraded its total secured AI factory capacity to 212 megawatts, up 80 megawatts from previous guidance.
SharonAI secured contracts worth over $8.8 billion year-to-date, showing strong demand.
SharonAI has secured an additional 80 megawatts in Australia, increasing its total secured AI factory capacity to 212 megawatts.
SharonAI secured 212 megawatts of capacity for deployment by the end of 2027.
risks: NVIDIA's six-year anchor commitment with guaranteed minimum revenue derisks the capital investment.

growth_drivers: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. sold the capacity for record dollars per hour, indicating strong customer demand.
We're getting detailed demand forecasts from AI natives, which gives us confidence and allows us to plan better.
The recent $1.32 billion contract for 10 petabytes of storage is a material upgrade from 3 petabytes.
SharonAI Holdings, Inc. is contracting at a faster rate and focusing on high-quality customers for its capacity.
AI natives are locking up as much compute as possible for 3- to 5-year terms.
risks: SharonAI Holdings, Inc. is expecting revenue to ramp up in Q4 due to hardware delivery and data center readiness.
